name: Nuku'esta
source:
Noie's familiar that looks like a black cat. It can understand and speak human language. Nuku'esta is vey knowledgeable when it comes to magic.

[Translated from [url=http://www.lunasys.info/?post_type=archive&s=%E3%83%8C%E3%82%AF%E3%82%A8%E3%82%B9%E3%82%BF]official website[/url].]
